description.to:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: M0; overlaps M1.
Exit criteria: Released (release R1 to R3 in PPY-e38a2d): PPY-94d609, PPY-31c45c, PPY-c020ce, PPY-9f929e, PPY-ce6207, PPY-752480, PPY-f60a1e, PPY-ef2c57, PPY-1ce06f, PPY-8f9462, PPY-0bb0fd, PPY-06ae68, PPY-7dc463 (part 1 PPY-cc8a4c); the projection writes under an output prefix (PPY-16d75b) and leases per tenant (PPY-1d5b1a); the adoption dry run on a Pilobolus copy reports zero tenant-less rows after apply.
Customer-visible: Nothing (dedicated sites behave exactly as before).
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: New tables only (Tenant, TenantMembership, TenantDomain, SiteDocumentVersion, TenantUsageCounter) plus PPY-1ce06f: one tenantId index on each listed table, all in one release (different tables), never on Reference, never in the release that carries Reference.publicFeedKey.
Contains: PPY-94d609, PPY-31c45c, PPY-c020ce, PPY-9f929e, PPY-ce6207, PPY-752480, PPY-f60a1e, PPY-ef2c57, PPY-1ce06f, PPY-8f9462, PPY-0bb0fd, PPY-06ae68, PPY-7dc463, PPY-cc8a4c, PPY-16d75b, PPY-1d5b1a
Follows: M0.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: A client without a tenant writes exactly as before (features_backend/tenant-field-everywhere.feature, PPY-94d609)
Scenario: A tenant client stamps its tenant on every write (same file)
Scenario: A tenant's members are found without a scan (features_backend/tenant-records.feature, PPY-31c45c)
Scenario: A member of two sites acts for one at a time (features_backend/tenant-session-claims.feature, PPY-0bb0fd)
Scenario: Group members keep today's access during stage 1 (features_backend/tenant-rules-additive.feature, PPY-06ae68)
Scenario: A function acts only for the caller's tenant (features_backend/function-tenant-context.feature, PPY-7dc463)
Scenario: Each tenant's References page reads only its own rows (features_backend/tenant-knowledge-keys.feature, PPY-ce6207)
Scenario: A single-tenant backend is copied into a tenant completely (features_backend/tenant-adoption-complete.feature, PPY-8f9462)
Scenario: A dedicated site's keys do not change (features_backend/tenant-output-prefix.feature, PPY-16d75b)

Acceptance checks:
1. Every dedicated site that took R1 to R3 passes its existing BDD suites and golden renders unchanged; synth templates identical apart from new tables and attributes.
2. npm run test:schema-parity, poetry run pytest and npm run test:bdd:backend green on develop.
3. Adoption report on a Pilobolus copy: zero tenant-less rows, second run changes nothing.
4. GSI ledger shows at most one new index per existing table per release.
